method: Name-matched against the HIFLD MIRTA (Military Installations, Ranges, and Training Areas) 'DoD Sites - Point' feature layer, filtered to the installation's state and scored by normalized token overlap. Renamed installations (e.g. Fort Hood/Fort Cavazos) and a handful of joint-base/co-location cases were resolved with a manual alias table; those are flagged in `notes` and capped at confidence 'medium'.
